work.title: Marte Schernito, componimento drammatico da cantarsi in occasione degli augusti sponzalizi di S. A. S. Guglielmo, principe ereditario Landgravio di Hesse-Cassel con S. A. R. Guglielmina Carolina principessa reale di Danimarca

Der verachtete Mars, ein Singgedicht. Am hochfeyerlichen Beylager Sr. hochfürstl. durchl. Herrn Wilhelms, Erbprinzens von Hessencassel mit ihrer königl. Hoheit Prinzeßin Wilhelmina Carolina, königlichen Prinzeßinn zu Dännemark

history.p: Scheibe was requested to compose a festive cantata in an Italian style for the marriage between Prince Vilhelm of Hesse-Cassel and Frederik V’s second oldest daughter, Princess Vilhelmine Caroline, in September 1764. The poet chosen for the project was Giovanni Francesco Darbes who was one of the Italian violinists arriving the same year as the Italian opera troupe (1747). The cantata, which included characters such as Mars, Mercury, Hymen, and Cupid, was performed during the official banquet at the royal palace, Christiansborg Slot, and led by Scheibe. The duration of the music corresponded apparently to the length of the banquet. Scheibe describes the cantata or 'das italienische Tafelstück' extensively in his Schreiben an die Herren Verfasser, 1765 (SchW C1:010), also dealing with how he had approached the commissioned work setting music to the text. He decided to compose it in the style of Johann Adolph Hasse, and apparently both friends and enemies liked it. It is one of the very few works that Scheibe composed to an Italian text, presumably because the contract stipulated that the cantata should be in the Italian style. For the work, Scheibe received the handsome gift of 450 Rigsdaler which was more than his yearly pension.

incipText.p: In dieser Königlichen Burg des Friedens
Wenn die Rede von einer Hochzeit ist
Di questi augusti sposi tu sommo Giove prendi
Du grosser Jupiter, trage für diese erlauchten Vermählten
Zum Verderben, zum Tödten eilend erfülle ich alles
Bravo da ver, gran capitano sei
Vortreflich! du bist ein grosser Held
Itzt lasset uns eilen, meine Freunde!
